deficiencies.description: The lecturer uses pointing words ('the tumor is here', 'This is the outer surface of the uterus') without stating their spatial relationship. The rewrite turns these pointing words into a specific spatial description ('The tumour lies next to the outer surface of the uterus') that is not established in the text.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: You can see that the tumor is here. This is the outer surface of the uterus.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: The tumour lies next to the outer surface of the uterus

considerations.sourcePassage: So you can see again that this is actually circumspect and very separate from the surrounding stroma and the surrounding tissue.
considerations.reason: The rewrite renders 'circumspect' as 'circumscribed'. In medical pathology, 'well-circumscribed' is the correct description for such tumours, so this represents the correction of an evident transcription error or slip of the tongue rather than a harmful distortion.

considerations.sourcePassage: And you can see here that this tumor, through the process of fixation and staining of this tumor, the hydration and dehydration of this tissue slice on the slide, has actually caused the tumor, which is, as I said, not invaded into the surrounding tissue to separate away from the normal muscle. So you can see again that this is actually circumspect and very separate from the surrounding stroma and the surrounding tissue.
considerations.reason: The rewrite uses 'therefore' ('The tumour is therefore circumscribed'), which reflects the speaker's inferential 'So you can see again that...' rather than introducing an unsourced causal link.

considerations.sourcePassage: and has, if you like, invaded within this tissue.
considerations.reason: 'if you like' was rephrased as 'in a sense', preserving the speaker's qualifying hedge.
